meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件发送通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送能力
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 会从 channels 分支复制 Resend 适配器、注册导入并安装固定版本依赖,从而获得通过 Resend 收发邮件的能力;还会把指定邮箱设为所有者并发出欢迎邮件。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Resend 邮件、给 NanoClaw 加上邮件回复功能,或要求集成邮件渠道时。需要你先在 Resend 完成账号、域名和密钥等人工设置。

say.text: 帮我把 Resend 邮件渠道加到 NanoClaw 里。
say.note: 技能会复制适配器并配置渠道。

say.text: 用 Resend 接入我的邮箱,发件地址用 bot@my.com。
say.note: 将你的地址设为所有者并接线。

say.text: 配置完 Resend 后,给我发一封欢迎邮件。
say.note: 会向你的邮箱发送 hello 邮件。

howto.what_en: When applied, NanoClaw copies the Resend adapter from the channels branch, registers the import, installs the pinned dependency, and wires your email as the owner, gaining email send/receive via Resend. After credentials are set, it greets you by email.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add the Resend email channel, enable email replies for NanoClaw, or integrate an email channel. Human setup on Resend (account, domain, keys) is required first.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and configures the channel.

say_en.text: Connect my email via Resend, using bot@my.com as sender.
Send me a welcome email once Resend is set up.
say_en.note: Delivers the hello message to your inbox.
